questions.question: Identify the correct sentence that uses inversion appropriately to emphasize the adverbial phrase 'Only after the lecture did she realize the importance of the topic.'
options: Only after the lecture did she realize the importance of the topic.
Only after the lecture she realized the importance of the topic.
After the lecture only did she realize the importance of the topic.
Only after the lecture has she realized the importance of the topic.
questions.answer: Only after the lecture did she realize the importance of the topic.

questions.question: Which of the following sentences correctly uses a cleft sentence to highlight the specific detail about the discovery?
options: It was the chemical reaction that caused the explosion.
The chemical reaction was it that caused the explosion.
The explosion was caused by the chemical reaction.
Causing the explosion was the chemical reaction.
questions.answer: It was the chemical reaction that caused the explosion.

questions.question: Select the correct form of the conditional sentence that expresses a hypothetical situation in the past which is contrary to fact.
options: If I had studied harder, I would have passed the exam.
If I had studied harder, I would pass the exam.
If I had studied harder, I would have passed the exam.
If I had studied harder, I will have passed the exam.
questions.answer: If I had studied harder, I would have passed the exam.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly employs the subjunctive mood to express a formal recommendation or requirement?
options: The committee recommends that all members attend the meeting.
The committee recommends that all members attends the meeting.
The committee recommends that all members attending the meeting.
The committee recommends that all members is attending the meeting.
questions.answer: The committee recommends that all members attend the meeting.

questions.question: Identify the correct sentence that demonstrates ellipsis, where a word is omitted but understood from context.
options: She finished her homework, and so did he.
She finished her homework, and he did too.
She finished her homework, and he finished as well.
She finished her homework, and he also finished.
questions.answer: She finished her homework, and so did he.
